# Brief: User Feedback Ingest & Review-Request Dialog

## Objective
Implement an accessible, end-to-end User Feedback and Defect Ingestion workflow (`review_request.js` + queue backend), supporting rich user feedback, client-side validation, envelope creation (`user-feedback-envelope@v1`), and receipt issuance.

## Context
Feature 0021 and Feature 0035 laid the groundwork. To make feedback submission fully experiential and secure without exposing browser PAT tokens, we need an interactive dialog on every documentation view that validates submissions, packages them into an append-only feedback queue under `_src/spec/feedback-queue/`, and provides a receipt with a tracking hash.

## Deliverables
1. `review_request.js` / Modal UI:
   - Floating / Header button "Feedback / Mangel melden" on every documentation view.
   - Form Fields:
     - Target Specification / Component ID (pre-populated from current page/section).
     - Category (Inhaltlich, Fehlende Information, Übersetzungsfehler, Unklarheit, Typo).
     - Title / Summary.
     - Detailed Description.
     - Proposed Change (optional text/markdown diff).
     - Severity: Blocker, Major, Minor, Editorial.
     - Submitter Handle / Email (optional or pseudonymous).
2. Data Envelope & Storage:
   - Generate schema-compliant `user-feedback-envelope@v1`:
     - `feedback_id`: UUID or timestamp-hash.
     - `submitted_at`: ISO timestamp.
     - `target_id`, `category`, `severity`, `description`, `proposed_change`.
     - `receipt_hash`: SHA-256 over canonical JSON.
   - Store in `_src/spec/feedback-queue/<timestamp>-<id>.json`.
   - Provide fallback local storage queuing if offline or server endpoint unreachable.
3. Receipt Modal:
   - On submission, display a receipt dialog showing the `feedback_id`, `receipt_hash`, and status "Eingereicht / In Warteschlange".
4. Integration into templates:
   - Connect trigger button in `_src/templates/page.html.tmpl`.
5. Tests:
   - Create `_src/tests/test_feedback_ingest.py` validating form validation, envelope formatting, SHA-256 receipt generation, and queue file creation.

## Acceptance Oracle
Run: `python3 -m unittest _src/tests/test_feedback_ingest.py` -> All tests PASS.
Commit all changes to your branch with a clear descriptive message.
